content: Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “An-gayaburba-berbeged an barmidasokalid, adi, an-iduar igar-mayegar. Ukiagwale be dule-dummad-amidimalad Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse nonikoed. Bemar bela-bela-dule-edarbediid igar-mesisad-gayaburba-berbeged-dule bato danikid.”
Degi-inigwele, ¿doa, e-iba-danikid-abin baisur-itogoe? ¿Doa, a-dule-danikir, e-asabin unni gwisguoe? Ar a-dule, soo-ibmar-swilidik-imakedyobi gued, morgauk olli-nanaid-eliedyobi gued.

A-dule, ibmar-swilidik-imakedga sigoed, mani-swilidik imakoed. Dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-Leví-wagan-swilidik imaknonikoed. Or, degi, mani, soogi-swilidik-imakedyobi imakoed. Geb, igar-innikigwad-maidba Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ukleged senonimaloed.
Ar igi-birga-nasmaladgi, degi, igi-epenneyobi, Bab-Jehová ega ibmar-ukleged yeer-itogedgi abingadae, deyobi Judá-dulemar-e-ibmar-uked, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-e-ibmar-uked Bab-Jehová abingaoed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “Degisoggu, an bemarga igar-nabogega an bemarse warmaknonikoed. We-dulemargi-ibmar-sogega an guagwar danikoed:
“Ani Bab-Jehová, an gege gwaged. A-ulale, bemar Jacob-wagan be bergussurmalad.”

Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “Be-dadgan-ibagan-akale, bemar an-igar-maidgi aibandimalad, eba be ibsadisurmalad. Be gannar anse dagmala, an gannar bemarse namogoed. ”Degi-inigwele, bemar sogmalad: ‘¿Ar ibiga anmar gannar bese naosunna?’

”¿Ar Bab-Dummad-ibe sunna dule ibmar-atursaoe? Ar bemar an-ibe ibmar atursadimalad. ”Degite, amba be sogmarbalid: ‘¿Ibu anmar be-ibe atursadimala?’ ”Ibmar-ambegi-gwensak-ukleged (10%), degi, anga ibmar-ukleged be atursadimalad.
Bemar, bela-dulemar-bukwamalad, be ukabsales bukwamalad, ar be an-ibe atursadimalad.”

Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “Bela-ibmar-ambegi-gwensak-uklegedi (10%), sogedba anse-goled-neggi-mani-ulu-siidse be sedamar, deyobi, an-neggi masgulleged nika guoed. We-ibmargi be an-wilubdakmardo, bule an bemarga nibneg-akale bendakleged barmidagosurdibe, degi, bule an bemarga ise-obinagwale ibmar ukosurbardibe.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogbalid: “Sesmar an bega obelogoed, adi, bemar-ibe ibmar-digar-nanaid mer obelogega, degi, nainugi uva-dub-digar-nanaid-e-san mer berguegar.
”Geb degine, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladi, bemarga sogmaloed, bemargi nued-binsalesye, ar bemarde, yar-yeerdakleged nikumaloed. Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad deyob soged.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemar ise-apole angi sunmakdimalad. ”Degite, amba be sogmarbalid: ‘¿Ibugi an begi ise-apole sunmakdimala?’
”Bemar sogsamalad: ‘Ar Bab-Dummadga-arbaedi, binsaledid. Ar Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-asabin, anmar e-igar-maidba-ibsaele, degi, wile-itoged-mor-yoele, ¿ibu wis anmar egi ibmar-nued amioe?

Ar anmar dakdimalad, dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdimaladi weligwar gudidiid. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladga ibmar nueganbi guddaed. Amala, Bab-Dummad-ourwega-imakdamalad, degite, gwen-sabsur odurdaklesurmalad.’ ”

Dulemar-Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanadimaladi, na muchub-muchub-sunmaksamalad, geb Bab-Jehová, a-dulemar-ibmar-soged nue-itogar imaksad. Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-wagab dulemar-Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanadimalad-e-nugmar, degi, Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummodimalad-e-nugmar, ebinsalegega gardagi narmaklesad.

Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “We-ibmar-imaked-iba bato danikid, we-dulemar unnila angadbi gumalaga an imakoed. We-dulemar an wiledakoed, igi baba na e-machi-ega-arbaed wiledake, deyobi an wiledakoed.”
Geb degine, bemar gannar magar-daknonimaloed, doa dule-nuedi, doa dule-isgana. Doa Bab-Dummad-nug odummoge, doa Bab-Dummad-nug odummosuli.
